reference.code: export function resolvePermissions(role:string,parents:Record<string,string>,grants:Record<string,string[]>):string[]|null{const seen=new Set<string>(),out=new Set<string>();while(role!==''){if(!(role in parents)&&!(role in grants)||seen.has(role))return null;seen.add(role);for(const p of grants[role]??[])out.add(p);role=parents[role]??''}return[...out].sort()}
